title: Racket Session Duration Goal Adherence by Sport
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=racket:session
| stats avg(duration_min) as actual count as sessions by sport
| eval pct_of_goal=round(100*actual/90.0,1), goal_label="90"
| sort pct_of_goal
description: Compares average session duration in minutes with a simple target for each sport, showing where racket session duration is meeting plan and where it is lagging.
value: Splitting target adherence by sport shows which contexts are helping you hit the plan and which ones need adjustment.
implementation: Set the target value in the query to match your routine, then review low-adherence sport values before the next session block.
visualization: Table of sport values with average session duration in minutes and percent of goal.
grandmaExplanation: It lists which sport settings help you hit your target for racket session duration and which ones fall short.
